name: Break Free
summary: Coffs Harbour ADSL + wireless-broadband + bundle ISP (Break Free Communications, T/A Australia Power Control Systems P/L); rebranded to Jazi (jazi.net) c. 2019 (THE TRUSTEE FOR THE ANDERSON FAMILY TRUST, ABN 81 844 880 166).

events.details: Break Free Communications, Coffs Harbour NSW; T/A Australia Power Control Systems P/L, 2 Peterson Road; ABN 81 844 880 166 (The Anderson Family Trust). Earliest breakfree.net.au capture 20 May 2001.
Retail homepage live through early 2019 (ADSL/ADSL2+/wireless plans); breakfree.net.au began 301-redirecting to jazi.net by 27 May 2019, i.e. rebranded/absorbed into Jazi.

Prior summary cited ACN 646 011 832 (BREAK FREE CORPORATION PTY LTD): a name-collision entity registered 19 Nov 2020, well after this ISP had rebranded to Jazi, so it does not belong to this record. The operating business was Break Free Communications (T/A Australia Power Control Systems P/L), ABN 81 844 880 166, cancelled 30 Nov 2022.
